verdict.rationale: PayPal's webhook API is explicitly documented: merchants can subscribe up to 10 webhook URLs per app, scoped to specific event types, with durable retry (25 attempts over 3 days) and signature verification guidance — enabling event-driven, agentic integrations. Missing for 10: explicit agentic-commerce-specific event types (e.g., cart/order events tied to AI checkout flows) and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
